messages.message: Are we still doing brunch on Saturday?
I was thinking around 11, if that works.
Yeah, 11 is good.
Somewhere with outdoor seating would be nice.
Please 😂
I need to get out of the house for a bit.
I’ll check that place near the park.
The one with the cinnamon pancakes? 🥞
That’s the one.
I pushed the changes to the shared folder.
The mobile spacing still needs one small adjustment.
Just saw them. The new layout is much easier to follow.
The button does sit a little high on my phone, though.
Agreed. I’ll move it down before lunch.
The review meeting got moved, right?
Yes, it’s tomorrow now.
So you have a bit more time to test.

conversations.last_message: So you have a bit more time to test.

messages.message: Has anyone confirmed what time we’re leaving on Sunday?
Dad is saying 10 now because he wants to stop at the market.
I thought we said 9:30.
Let’s just settle on one time before everyone starts messaging separately 😅
Auntie has already told people 9.
I can’t keep up with this family.
I’ll put the final plan in the group.
Please do. Departure at 10, then.
Quick question: do these shoes look too formal for everyday wear?
I’m trying not to buy things I’ll wear once.
They’d work with jeans too.
Think about what you already own that would go with them.
Black trousers, blue jeans, maybe that cream dress.
Okay, that’s actually more outfits than I expected.
Exactly. Sleep on it before buying.
Good idea. The sale countdown is stressing me out 🙃

conversations.last_message: Good idea. The sale countdown is stressing me out 🙃

messages.message: Are you watching the match tonight?
Probably. What time?
Kickoff is 8.
A few of us are meeting at the usual spot if you want to join.
I might make the second half.
Save me a seat this time.
I’ll try 😂
No promises if it gets crowded.

conversations.last_message: No promises if it gets crowded.

messages.message: I need your honest opinion on a birthday gift.
Book she mentioned or a voucher for that pottery class?
Did she talk about the book more than once?
Twice, actually.
She sent me a review last week too.
Then I’d go with the book and add a handwritten note.
That feels more personal. Thank you ❤️
Glad I could help.
Did the electricity contribution go through?
I sent mine this morning.
I’ll forward the receipt so you have the reference.
Got it now, thanks.
I’m still waiting on two people.
Can you share the total once everyone has paid?
Yes, I’m tracking it in the spreadsheet.
Much easier than searching through the chat later.

conversations.last_message: Much easier than searching through the chat later.

messages.message: I tried the rice recipe you sent.
It came out good, but I think I added too much stock.
That happened to me the first time too.
Add a little water next time and taste before adding salt.
I also threw in smoked fish.
That part was excellent, honestly.
Now you’re improving my recipe 😄
I’ll write down what I changed and send it over.

conversations.last_message: I’ll write down what I changed and send it over.

messages.message: I found a flight that’s cheaper.
But it lands just after 11 pm instead of 6:30.
Would we still be able to get to the hotel easily?
There’s an airport shuttle.
I need to check when the last one leaves.
Check that before booking. The savings aren’t worth being stranded.
A taxi might wipe out the difference anyway.
Fair point. I’ll compare the total cost.

conversations.last_message: Fair point. I’ll compare the total cost.

messages.message: They’re asking everyone to confirm for the reunion by Friday.
Still no final food details, though.
Do they have a venue yet?
The school hall, apparently.
I’ll confirm once they share the contribution amount.
Can you forward the announcement?
Sent it now.
Let me know if the link opens for you.

conversations.last_message: Let me know if the link opens for you.

messages.message: The plumber says he can come Thursday afternoon.
He asked if someone can be home between 3 and 4.
That should work if you can get back by then.
I can leave work early.
I’ll ask for a message before he sets off.
Good idea. Please keep the invoice too.
Of course. I’ll send a photo when it’s done.

conversations.last_message: Of course. I’ll send a photo when it’s done.

messages.message: I found the pictures from our beach day last year.
Look at this one 😭
Why am I holding my sandals like that?
I look like I’m escaping a flood.
Because you insisted the water wasn’t cold.
You lasted about three seconds.
I was trying to be brave, okay.
I’m putting these in the shared album tonight.

conversations.last_message: I’m putting these in the shared album tonight.

messages.message: I’m about to submit the application. Can you check one last thing?
Here’s the sentence I’m unsure about.
Send it over.
“I am excited to contribute my experience to your team.”
That’s fine, but add one specific skill you’d bring to the role.
Mention the monthly reports and how you improved the process.
That’s much stronger.
Updating it now. Thanks.
The tickets went on sale earlier than I expected.
I managed to get two!
Amazing. Where are the seats?
Upper level, but at least we’re in.
The fees were ridiculous, obviously 🙃
Send me the payment details and I’ll transfer my half.
Just sent them.
Before Friday is fine.
The delivery app says my package was handed to a neighbour.
It doesn’t say which neighbour, of course.
Check the delivery photo and ask the building manager.
There’s no photo.
I’ve messaged support now.
Keep the order number handy. They’ll probably ask for it.
Found it in the email.
I’ll wait for their reply.
We still need two people for Saturday’s food drive.
Setup starts at 8:30, distribution at 10.
I can help with setup, but I need to leave by noon.
That’s useful. We need help packing the first batch.
Put me down for that shift.
I’ll bring gloves too.
Thank you! I’ll send the location pin and checklist.

conversations.last_message: Thank you! I’ll send the location pin and checklist.

messages.message: I listened to the album you recommended on my commute.
First two tracks were good.
The last one is now stuck in my head.
Track four is my favourite.
That’s the one that gets you.
I replayed it twice and missed my stop.
That is both a compliment and a transport problem.
Send me another album, but maybe one for a shorter commute.

conversations.last_message: Send me another album, but maybe one for a shorter commute.

messages.message: Are you free for coffee sometime next week?
Tuesday or Thursday after 4 should work.
Thursday is better for me.
There’s a new place on Broad Street I wanted to try.
Send me the name. I’ll check how to get there.
Just sent the page.
Booked in my calendar. See you then.

conversations.last_message: Booked in my calendar. See you then.
